Welcome to Integrated Massage Therapy College in Edmonds, Oklahoma! At IMTC, our entire team is committed to helping start a fulfilling career in massage therapy. We show our students the inner workings and fundamentals of the massage therapy field while allowing them to work directly with clients at our massage clinic for first-hand learning. We offer a wide range of massage therapy programs designed to help you thrive in your chosen field. What’s more, we can help students get the financial assistance they need to achieve their goals, and can assist graduates with job placement. 

Follow our YouTube channel to watch insightful and entertaining videos that explore our programs and cover a variety of topics relating to massage, health, wellness, self-care, and more! Visit IMTC to get more information for enrollment, and apply today! It’s time to restore the balance in your career!

#IMTCollege #MassageSchool #MassageTherapySchool #MassagCollege #MassageTherapy #MassageTherapist
